rows.label: Speed · 10U
rows.note: 10U: average 32–36 mph, good 37–40, elite 41–44. Every pitch except the changeup. The chart does not say how it was measured; its 18U numbers agree with the Diamond Solutions / Rapsodo high school scale (senior 60+).
rows.source: CommitBound, Softball Pitching Speed Chart by Age (no published method)
